title: 3 new npm packages for React Native & Expo
text: rn-privacy-manifest-check finds missing iOS privacy manifest entries, eas-config-check catches Expo / EAS config mismatches, and use-timezone-overlap shows your working hours in a client's time zone. Free, MIT-licensed, zero dependencies.
